The [[AestheTech Incorporated]] '''Appearance Designer''' was a beauty device in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] that could painlessly alter any part of the body. While the technical specifications of the Appearance Designer were a well kept secret, all major galactic medical and safety organizations approved of it.

==Behind the scenes==
The Appearance Designer first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' update 2.1 as a method of altering the player's appearance. The player's species can be altered, which is most likely just a game mechanic.
